title: Kushner: Trump 'Open to the Idea' of NATO Protection for Ukraine
detail: US envoy Jared Kushner said President Trump is 'open to the idea' of NATO protection for Ukraine, per Le Monde's live coverage. Only the headline was available; the specifics and any conditions are not verified.

title: Russia reportedly open to 'NATO-like' status for Ukraine if Putin keeps captured territory
detail: A report relayed via Google News, citing a US official, says Russia is open to a 'NATO-like' security status for Ukraine, but only if Putin keeps the territory Russia has captured. Only the headline was available; the originating outlet, the terms and any Russian confirmation are not verified.
